before: This app has no plan tool. The summary was shown in the previous reply: every Monday 8:00 am, 3 LinkedIn drafts about hiring, they wait for your yes, uses credits each run, saved switched off.

arguments.name: Weekly LinkedIn, hiring
arguments.goal: 3 LinkedIn drafts about hiring every Monday
arguments.instructions: 3 LinkedIn drafts about hiring every Monday. Never invent facts, numbers, prices or dates.

steps.why: Weekly posts, the default kind for steady presence; weekly at 3 fits what most people can review. The time zone is required and has no fallback. Accounts are bound as objects, and they decide the networks: platforms is sent only when the user limits networks, so an account added later is used. count goes with artifact_type every time output_config is sent. Ask me first unless the user said post without asking. Saved switched off: no activate-routine on this yes.

say: Saved to Acme, switched off: Weekly LinkedIn, hiring, every Monday 8:00 am (New York). Switch it on?
never: activate-routine on the yes to save: switching on is its own yes.
A bare 'routine' where the app's own scheduling could be meant.
Leaving count out of output_config: Bolta would use its writer's default, 4.
